content.text: In Nigeria, where Stripe is restricted, launching a successful digital store is a daunting task. Without a reliable payment processing system, even the most promising entrepreneurs are forced to abandon their dreams. But what if you could build a crypto store on Cloudflare Pages, without relying on Stripe or any other platform? With COREMERCH, you can deploy a fully operational online store in 48 hours, complete with automatic crypto payment processing and instant product delivery. This guide will walk you through the process of building a crypto store on Cloudflare Pages, no Stripe required.
Why This Infrastructure Works When Platforms Fail

The problem with traditional payment processing platforms is that they're often restrictive and expensive. But with COREMERCH, you own the infrastructure from day one, and there are no subscriptions or hidden fees. By deploying a sovereign digital commerce stack, you're not just building a store – you're creating a business that's truly independent and resilient. This infrastructure works when platforms fail because it's built on free and open-source tools, including GitHub Pages, Cloudflare Pages, and NOWPayments.
What You Need Before You Deploy

Before you can deploy your crypto store on Cloudflare Pages, you'll need to set up a few essential components. First, you'll need to create a GitHub account and set up a new repository for your store. Next, you'll need to install the Cloudflare Pages CLI and authenticate with your Cloudflare account. Finally, you'll need to configure your NOWPayments account and link it to your Cloudflare Pages project. With these components in place, you'll be ready to deploy your store in no time.
Setting Up Your Payment and Delivery Pipeline

Once you've deployed your store on Cloudflare Pages, it's time to set up your payment and delivery pipeline. With NOWPayments, you can easily integrate automatic crypto payment processing and instant product delivery. To do this, you'll need to configure your NOWPayments account to use the Cloudflare Pages API, and then set up a delivery pipeline using Google Drive or Cloudflare R2. With this pipeline in place, you'll be able to process payments and deliver products to your customers instantly.
Deploying a sovereign digital commerce stack is the key to building a successful digital store that's truly independent and resilient.
Going Live and Processing Your First Transaction

Now that your payment and delivery pipeline is set up, it's time to go live and process your first transaction. To do this, simply click the "Deploy" button on your Cloudflare Pages project, and then follow the prompts to activate your NOWPayments account. Once you've completed these steps, you'll be ready to start selling your digital products and processing payments. With COREMERCH, you can deploy a fully operational online store in 48 hours, complete with automatic crypto payment processing and instant product delivery.
Scaling Once the Infrastructure Is Running

Once your infrastructure is running, it's time to start scaling your business. With COREMERCH, you can easily add new products, customers, and features to your store without any downtime or disruption. To do this, simply use the Cloudflare Pages API to update your store configuration, and then use NOWPayments to process payments and deliver products to your customers. With this infrastructure in place, you'll be able to grow your business quickly and efficiently, without worrying about platform restrictions or fees.
